description: AI Brand Audit System. Activate when a user wants to evaluate an existing brand name — asking "is my name good?", "should I rebrand?", "what's wrong with my name?", "how does my brand compare to competitors?", or when they express doubt about their current name. Also trigger when a user shares their company/product name in passing and it shows clear weaknesses (mispronunciation risk, generic patterns, trademark exposure). Produces a scored audit with weakness severity ratings and a clear recommendation: keep, optimize, refresh, or full rebrand. When a full rebrand is recommended, activate DomainForge automatically.
